Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Job Title: Private Equity Investor Product Strategy, Associate

Job Description:
The Investor Product Strategy team is responsible for the preparation of marketing and fundraising materials and reporting related to each respective business’ funds.

The role focuses on financial analysis, investor reporting, developing investor-facing deliverables, and performance-related data to support the marketing and content needs of all prospective and current investors in the funds within the Private Equity business.

Key Responsibilities:
- Prepare and analyze detailed investment reports ensuring accurate and timely delivery of financial insights to investors and collaborating with other internal finance teams to provide data driven support and content for investor relations activities

- Assist with the preparation and review of marketing and fundraising materials including roadshow and investor event presentations, conference/webinar materials, pitch books, talking points, performance memos, and other messaging/communications
- Coordinate with the fundraising team, deal team, and other finance and functional groups to collate and review investor/distributor due diligence requests and assist with investor queries
- Coordinate the collection and analysis of performance metrics of the funds and underlying companies and other portfolio attributes across multiple internal teams and assist in preparation and review of bespoke fund performance analyses
- Draft presentations and analyses including marketing/fundraising updates, talking points, and deal books for senior management
- Collaborate with the fundraising and marketing teams, deal teams, finance teams, and legal and compliance teams in supporting product development, existing clients and prospective investors

Qualifications:
- Undergraduate degree in Finance, Marketing, Accounting, Economics, or a quantitative discipline;
- Strong record of academic achievement and/or professional accomplishment
- 3+ years of experience in a content creation related role in finance, investor reporting, transaction services, investment operations, consulting, or other related experience
- Strong attention to detail
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and verbal
- Outstanding organizational skills
- Strong analytical and quantitative experience
- Strong work ethic; works effectively in a dynamic team environment and handles multiple projects
- Highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint
- Highly motivated and results oriented

jobs.title: Product Manager, AVP - Private Wealth Technology
jobs.description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at www.blackstone.com . Follow @blackstone on  LinkedIn ,  X (Twitter) , and  Instagram .
Business Description:
Blackstone Technology & Innovations (BXTi) is the technology team at the core of each of Blackstone's businesses and new growth initiatives. Serving both internal and external clients, we work to build the next generation of systems that manage risk, create efficiency, and improve transparency within the firm and across our broad community of investors and portfolio companies.

BXTi is nimble and entrepreneurial. Our open, iterative design processes and rapid pace of development mean that everyone on the team can make an impact from day one. We are problem solvers who take projects from idea to implementation. We believe in active mentoring, developing excellence, and collaborating to find the best answers for our customers and for Blackstone. We are critical to the firm maintaining its competitive edge.

Private Wealth continues to grow, driving increased demand for technology solutions that support our advisors, clients, and distribution teams. Team members are exposed to a broad range of initiatives spanning Product, Sales, Marketing, Investor Services, Operations, and Data, with the opportunity to solve meaningful business problems and directly influence how the business scales.

Job Description:
We are seeking an Assistant Vice President to serve as a hands-on technology operator within the Private Wealth Technology team. This individual will move across critical initiatives based on business need, including CRM, advisor-facing platforms, sales and marketing technology, customer data, analytics, workflow solutions, digital experience platforms, and emerging AI capabilities. Core platforms may include Salesforce, Agentforce, Microsoft Copilot, customer data platforms (CDPs), reporting and analytics tools, content management systems, and advisor-facing digital experiences.

The role is heavily focused on implementation and execution. The successful candidate will take ambiguous business problems, understand the underlying systems and technical tradeoffs, translate decisions into executable requirements, and drive delivery through launch and adoption. This person does not need to be an engineer, but must be technically fluent, comfortable working closely with engineering and architecture teams, and have a willingness to challenge whether a proposed solution will work operationally and scale over time.

This is an individual-contributor role for someone who can quickly enter a project, establish structure, connect business and technology teams, and take accountability for delivering complete outcomes. Success in the role requires balancing immediate business needs with long-term technology considerations, making pragmatic decisions that drive results while supporting a scalable and sustainable enterprise platform.

The ideal candidate combines business curiosity, technical fluency, and relentless execution. They are comfortable moving between strategic discussions and implementation details, quickly learning unfamiliar domains, and building trust with stakeholders through consistent delivery. They can assess problems from both a business and technology perspective, challenge assumptions, apply first-principles thinking, and take ownership from initial problem definition through production launch and adoption.

Responsibilities:
- Lead Cross-Platform Implementation - Own technology initiatives from problem definition through implementation, testing, launch, and stabilization. Move fluidly across Salesforce, advisor portals, data platforms, reporting solutions, workflow tools, and operational processes based on team priorities.
- Translate Business Needs into Executable Delivery - Turn ambiguous business problems into clear requirements, process flows, system behaviors, data needs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans. Ensure engineering teams have the clarity required to build effectively.
- Understand Technical Tradeoffs - Partner with engineering, architecture, data, and integration teams to evaluate solution options and dependencies. Understand how decisions affect scalability, maintainability, data quality, user workflows, downstream systems, and long-term platform strategy.
- Drive End-to-End Outcomes - Manage dependencies across business and technology teams and actively resolve issues that could prevent delivery. Stay involved through testing, release readiness, rollout, and post-launch stabilization rather than handing work off after requirements are written.
- Operationalize Solutions - Define how new capabilities will work in practice, including ownership, controls, exception handling, support processes, documentation, and adoption. Ensure solutions can be sustained and scaled after implementation.
- Build Trusted Partnerships - Develop strong relationships across business and technology teams through accountability, transparency, and consistent execution. Communicate progress, risks, tradeoffs, and decisions proactively while maintaining stakeholder trust and alignment.
- Connect Work Across Systems and Teams - Identify when a solution requires coordinated changes across CRM, portals, data, reporting, marketing, investor servicing, and operational platforms. Push for complete business outcomes rather than isolated features or point solutions.
- Drive Execution and Accountability - Create structure in ambiguous environments and translate objectives into actionable plans. Identify dependencies, sequence work effectively, proactively remove blockers, and ensure commitments are delivered with quality and urgency.
- Evaluate and Navigate Technology Tradeoffs - Assess solution options across platforms, applications, and data domains. Balance business priorities, delivery timelines, operational considerations, and long-term architectural goals to recommend solutions that create durable enterprise value rather than isolated point solutions.
- Apply First-Principles Thinking - Challenge assumptions and approach problems with curiosity and critical thinking. Develop a deep understanding of the underlying business objective and evaluate solutions through the lens of both business value and enterprise technology strategy.

Qualifications:
Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who work well in a team-driven working group, are highly motivated, intelligent, have sound judgment and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors. The successful candidate should possess the following qualities:

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Finance, Business Analytics, or a related field preferred
- 8+ years of experience in consulting, financial services, technology delivery, business analysis, project leadership, product implementation, or a related discipline
- Demonstrated experience leading implementation efforts from requirements through testing, launch, and operational adoption
- Strong technical fluency, including the proficiency to understand system architecture, integrations, APIs, data flows, environments, and technical dependencies
- Experience working directly with engineers, architects, data teams, and business stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle
- Skill to evaluate technical options and clearly explain tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical audiences
- Experience translating complex business and operational needs into detailed functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flows
- Adeptness to enter unfamiliar initiatives, quickly understand the business problem and system landscape, and establish a path to delivery
- Strong execution discipline with experience managing scope, dependencies, risks, milestones, testing, release readiness, and post-launch issues
- Proven experience building credibility and trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the facility to simplify complex concepts and influence decision-making across distinct audiences
- Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated skill to learn new business domains, technologies, and operating models quickly
- Strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills, including the competence to challenge assumptions and apply first-principles thinking
- Comfortable operating as an individual contributor across multiple projects and technology domains simultaneously
- Experience with Salesforce or another enterprise CRM platform strongly preferred
- Experience with Jira, Confluence, reporting tools, data platforms, and cloud-based enterprise applications preferred
- Financial Services or Wealth Management experience is helpful but not required

All projects are prioritized and selected to achieve measurable operational efficiencies and contribute to our stakeholders’ technology strategy.

- Partner closely with engineering teams to design scalable, maintainable solutions using modern programming languages and architectures

- Manage project delivery – define milestones, track progress, and provide clear updates to stakeholders

- Lead user acceptance testing (UAT) with a focus on validating logic, data integrity, and system behavior

- Oversee data migration, reconciliation, and validation, ensuring accuracy and auditability of outputs

- Collaborate with offshore and affiliate teams with an emphasis on clear technical communication and alignment

- Serve as a technical-functional bridge, supporting end users while guiding adoption of more robust, engineering-driven solutions

- Promote and establish best practices in system design, data management, and process automation

- 7+ years of experience in product management, business analysis, or software engineering, preferably in a hybrid or highly technical role

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or related field

- Prior experience in real estate or private equity along with knowledge of performance calculations, deal life cycle, forecasting, and investor reporting

- Demonstrated experience working closely with engineering teams and translate business requirements into implementable technical specifications

- Strong working knowledge of programming and data manipulation (e.g., Python, SQL APIs, data pipelines, or backend logic preferred)

- Experience designing or contributing to code-based solutions (beyond configuration-driven tools)

- Familiarity with software development concepts: version control, testing, modular design, and deployment practices

- Experience with modern data/BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Sigma) with an understanding of underlying data structures

- Exposure to cloud platforms or modern data architectures is a plus

- Experience operating as a hands-on individual contributor while influencing technical direction

- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with comfort operating in complex environments

- Excellent communication skills, with experience bridging business and technical audiences effectively

- Experience summarizing complex concepts succinctly for senior stakeholders

- Comfortable working in a global, cross-functional team environment

Technology Operations Product Owner – Endpoint Management – Associate

Role Summary

This role is responsible for the end-to-end operational success, service ownership, and product lifecycle management of the enterprise Endpoint Management ecosystem, including Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Configuration Manager (SCCM), Group Policy, Windows Applications, Windows Endpoints, Mobile Device Management (iOS and Android), macOS Device Management, Windows Server Update Services (WSUS), and Endpoint Security Governance.
The individual will serve as the operational authority and product owner for endpoint management services, ensuring platform stability, scalability, governance, compliance, security, user experience, and operational excellence across the enterprise device landscape.

The ideal candidate combines deep endpoint management expertise with operational leadership, product ownership, service management, analytics, vendor management, and workplace technology transformation experience. They must be capable of driving operational excellence, influencing engineering and architecture roadmaps, and partnering with business and technology leadership teams to modernize endpoint services while maintaining highly reliable, secure, and compliant endpoint environments.

Key Responsibilities

Product Ownership & Operational Leadership of Endpoint Management Platforms
- Own the end-to-end strategy, governance, and operational lifecycle of endpoint management platforms including Microsoft Intune, SCCM, Group Policy, Windows applications, mobile devices, macOS management, and WSUS, ensuring scalable, reliable, secure, and supportable service delivery.

- Serve as the accountable product and operational leader for endpoint management services by driving platform health, user experience, compliance, security posture, and business outcomes while aligning engineering, support, security, architecture, and business stakeholders to continuously evolve and improve the endpoint ecosystem.

Service Operations & Incident Management
- Lead major incident and outage management for endpoint management services, coordinating triage, escalation, communications, and cross-functional resolution efforts to minimize business disruption and restore services quickly.

- Leverage monitoring tools, endpoint telemetry, operational analytics, and device health insights to identify root causes, drive sustainable remediation efforts, and continuously improve endpoint reliability and performance.

Problem Management & Root Cause Analysis
- Own and drive problem management across endpoint platforms by analyzing recurring device, application, patching, policy, and compliance issues.

- Lead root cause investigations, maintain operational knowledge repositories and corrective action plans, and partner with engineering teams to implement lasting improvements that enhance endpoint stability, security, and user productivity.

Endpoint Experience Monitoring & Service Health
- Establish and optimize service health frameworks for endpoint management platforms by defining KPIs, SLIs, and SLOs.

- Implement proactive monitoring and observability solutions while leveraging analytics to improve device performance, application reliability, patch compliance, user satisfaction, and overall digital workplace experience.

Capacity Planning & Performance Management
- Drive capacity planning and operational readiness for endpoint management platforms by analyzing device growth, software deployment trends, patching requirements, and operational demand.

- Establish governance and scalability standards while proactively mitigating platform, licensing, infrastructure, and operational risks to support future growth and modernization initiatives.

Product Lifecycle, Change & Release Readiness
- Own change governance and operational readiness for endpoint management platforms by establishing release management standards, deployment validation processes, supportability requirements, and post-release monitoring.

- Ensure successful deployment and adoption of operating system upgrades, application releases, mobile platform updates, policy changes, and endpoint modernization initiatives.

Platform Subject Matter Expertise
- Serve as the principal endpoint management subject matter expert and escalation leader, providing strategic guidance and resolving complex endpoint-related issues.

- Influence product strategy, governance, architecture, and engineering roadmaps through operational insights and industry best practices to enhance endpoint reliability, security, manageability, and end-user productivity.

Software Deployment & Application Management
- Oversee enterprise application packaging, testing, deployment, lifecycle management, and retirement across Windows and macOS platforms.

- Establish governance and operational standards for application delivery while ensuring compatibility, security, user experience, and deployment success.

Device Compliance, Security & Patch Management
- Partner with Security, Infrastructure, and Risk teams to establish and maintain endpoint compliance standards, security baselines, configuration policies, and patch governance.

- Lead operational ownership of operating system updates, third-party patching processes, vulnerability remediation activities, and compliance reporting across Windows, mobile, and macOS environments.

Vendor & Partner Management
- Manage strategic vendor and partner relationships supporting endpoint management services by governing service delivery, SLAs, performance metrics, and accountability frameworks.

- Lead escalations and coordinate with vendors to ensure timely resolution of critical issues and achievement of operational commitments.

Operational Analytics & Executive Reporting
- Define and lead operational analytics and executive reporting for endpoint management services by developing device health scorecards, compliance metrics, patching dashboards, deployment success measurements, and operational performance reports.

- Deliver data-driven insights that inform strategic decisions, operational improvements, investment priorities, and roadmap planning while providing clear visibility to executive stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement, Automation & Modern Management
- Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence across endpoint services by leveraging automation, scripting, orchestration platforms, and modern management capabilities.

- Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort, improve endpoint security and compliance, accelerate issue resolution, and enhance the overall employee endpoint experience through automation and innovation.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 5+ years of experience in Endpoint Management, Workplace Technology, End User Computing (EUC), Desktop Engineering, Device Management, or Infrastructure Operations.

- 3+ years of experience in product ownership, service ownership, operational leadership, or platform management roles.

- Experience managing large-scale enterprise endpoint environments supporting thousands of users and devices.

- Proven track record leading endpoint operations, technology modernization, incident management, compliance initiatives, and workplace technology transformation programs.

Technical Expertise

Business Unit:
Blackstone Private Wealth, Tokyo

Business Unit Overview:
Blackstone Private Wealth (BXPW) was established to answer the growing demand for Blackstone products from high-net worth investors. Partnering with many of the world’s largest private banks and wealth management firms as well as family offices, Blackstone’s Private Wealth Solutions team packages and delivers the full breadth of Blackstone’s alternative product capability to these firms and their clients and provides ongoing product and advisor support, as well as education and training around alternatives.

Job Title: Product Strategy, Analyst/Associate

Global Product Strategy:
Global Product Strategy is focused on designing flagship, category-killing products that deliver Blackstone’s investment capabilities, redefining the accessibility of alternatives for private wealth clients. As a member of the team, the individual will be responsible for driving the design and end-to-end development of new funds. The ideal candidate will be creative and passionate about researching and creating innovative product structures and solutions to unlock new markets and distribution channels.
The team provides domain knowledge and expertise on investments, performance, market dynamics and competitors. Global Product Strategy has key internal and external stakeholders, including Blackstone investment teams, Blackstone Private Wealth sales professionals, banking teams, financial advisors, and clients.

Job Description:
The Japan Product Strategist will focus on product development, supporting Blackstone Private Wealth's initiatives mainly in Japan.
Primary job responsibilities will include:
- Drive and supporting the development of Blackstone Private Wealth's business in Japan by creating products that are relevant to the local client base.

- Develop domestic and international structures/solutions mindful of appropriate regulatory frameworks and constraints.

- Play a significant role interfacing with members of the firm’s global Blackstone Private Wealth group's across all Blackstone investment funds, legal/compliance department, finance and other groups within the firm.

- Conduct research on product structures, regulatory developments and competitor fund launches to help identify scale opportunities.

- Work with internal Blackstone teams on the full scope of product development, including the buildout of operations, technology, marketing and finance.

Qualifications:
Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who work well in a team-driven working group, are highly motivated, intelligent, have sound judgment and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors.
The successful candidate must have:

- Minimum 3 years’ relevant work experience

- Deep knowledge of fund structuring and regulations

- Relevant product development experience in asset management industry

- Knowledge of alternative funds and strategies

- A high level of attention to detail

- Fluent in Japanese with business-level proficiency in English

- Great presentation skills

- A desire to work in a team environment, often against competing deadlines

- Experience in project management and if the experience is across global/NY-based teams

- Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills
